fact: The NCC list of ground segment operators shows nationwide VSAT licences on more than one satellite network, including Starlink Internet Services Nigeria (Starlink, effective 16 Jun 2026), Airtel (OneWeb, 24 Jan 2023), Tizeti (Eutelsat Konnect, 17 Jul 2023) and Viasat Nigeria (Hylas-4, 19 Oct 2023).
title: Ground Segment
